caption: The drawing depicts a long, loose-fitting garment, resembling a nightgown or smock, that reaches to the ankles. The garment is primarily off-white or cream in color, with subtle shading to indicate folds and drapery of the fabric. It features long sleeves that are gathered at the cuffs, also secured with decorative trim or lace edging. The front of the garment has a vertical row of buttons running from the collar down to the hem. The upper yoke area is adorned with intricate lace or embroidered detailing in a symmetrical pattern, which extends across the shoulders and around the collar. The collar is small and rounded, edged with matching decorative trim. The overall appearance is soft and flowing, with gentle shadows to show the texture and folds of the fabric. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details.
title: Nightgown
